notes.title: Are you ready for the Challenges?
notes.content:
[b]Reporting in, Commander!
[/b]Get ready for an epic adventure with our latest update. We've added a new challenge mode, with 320 new levels with altered battle conditions to test your skills. And that's not all! We've also introduced new GEN tokens to help you enhance your character's attack, defense, speed and more.

New characters have also been added to the mix! Introducing Onix, Kana, Alyss, Anemona and Selene, new sexy characters that will join you in your battles. And if you're looking for an even greater challenge, don't miss the chance to unlock Morgana, the new character available in one of the Challenges.

This update is sure to bring you hours of fun and excitement. So what are you waiting for?
Are you ready for the Challenges?
